description.subject: Young woman, around early 20s, fair lightly sun-kissed skin with faint freckles, shoulder-length to chest-length wavy dark brown hair with natural volume falling forward over both shoulders, thick dark eyebrows, minimal natural makeup

description.lighting: Bright natural sunlight from the upper right, warm golden tones, soft highlights on skin and hair, dappled shade in the background
description.composition: Vertical medium shot from mid-thigh to head, subject centered and slightly left, camera at roughly eye-to-chest level facing her across the table, table edge and cups cropping the bottom of the frame
description.style: Candid lifestyle / editorial summer photography with a film-like analog look, slight grain, photorealistic, Mediterranean vacation aesthetic
description.colors: Cream, lemon yellow, warm skin tones, white, grey stone, deep green, touches of red and blue
description.mood: Relaxed, sunny, carefree, playful summer holiday vibe
